test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a circular race of 500 m length, A and B start with speeds of 4 m/sec and 5 m/sec, respectively, at the same time from the same point. After how much time will they meet for the first time at the starting point while running in the same direction?
solution:
**Given:**

Circular track length (L) = 500 m Speed of A (Va) = 4 m/sec Speed of B (Vb) = 5 m/sec

**Formula used:**

The relative speed (Vr) = Vb - Va

**Calculation:**

Vr = 5 m/sec - 4 m/sec = 1 m/sec

The time (t) they meet for the first time at the starting point can be found using the formula: t = L / Vr

t = 500 / 1 = 500 seconds

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
